title: Characterization and Construction of Pairwise Orthogonal Parseval Frames with Applications to Sampling
summary: In this paper, we provide a characterization of pairwise orthogonal frames with generalized translation-invariant (GTI) structures, based on the unconditional convergence property (UCP). These GTI systems are generated by translating functions over a countable family of closed, co-compact subgroups of a locally compact abelian (LCA) group $G$, where the families of subgroups associated with each system may differ.
